scope: Local pre-publication source gates. Remote CI, tag, asset download and published-install evidence belongs to the subsequent GitHub Actions run and release readback.
installation_scope: Local installation previously passed for the unchanged frozen runtime; committed and published-tag installation are separate CI gates.
claim_boundary: No structural, test or archive result certifies visual maturity, scope appropriateness or owner acceptance.

whitespace_check.scope: Authored source; raw experiment/review/shared-input archives preserve original whitespace via -whitespace attribute.
